1.title: Cloud Concepts and Connectivity
1.text: Welcome to Module three: Cloud Concepts and Connectivity. It covers the exam area one point zero Networking Concepts. Each part of this module comes from the study notes of the same name, so you can read the notes after you watch.

1.title: What You Will Learn
1.text: By the end of this module you will be able to do seven things. one point three Summarize cloud concepts and connectivity options: network functions virtualization (N F V). Virtual private cloud (V P C). Network security groups and lists. Cloud gateways (internet gateway, nat gateway). V P N (virtual private network) and Direct Connect. Public, private and hybrid deployment. Practice with exam-style questions and a recall check.

1.title: Where This Fits in the Exam
1.text: Here is where this module sits in the exam. Exam area: one point zero Networking Concepts (twenty-three percent). Exam format: up to ninety questions in ninety minutes; a score of seven hundred twenty on a scale of one hundred to nine hundred passes. Validated against: the official Comp T I A Network plus N ten to nine exam objectives, version four point zero.

1.title: Cloud building blocks
1.text: Cloud building blocks. Network functions virtualization (N F V). Running network functions (routing, firewalling, load balancing) as software on standard servers instead of dedicated hardware. Virtual private cloud (V P C). A logically isolated private network inside a public cloud, with your own I P ranges, subnets and routes. Network security group. Stateful rules applied to instances or network interfaces. Network security list or network A C L. Rules applied to a subnet, often stateless (return traffic needs its own rule).

1.title: Cloud building blocks, continued
1.text: Cloud building blocks. Internet gateway. Lets a V P C reach the internet and be reached (with public I P s). nat gateway. Lets private instances start outbound connections to the internet without being reachable from it.

1.title: Cloud building blocks, continued
1.text: Cloud building blocks. The figure shows this: A V P C with public and private subnets, an internet gateway, a nat gateway and a connection to on premises. Exam tip: Private servers need updates from the internet but must not be reachable equals nat gateway. Public web servers equals internet gateway plus public I P s.

1.title: Connecting to the cloud
1.text: Connecting to the cloud. V P N. Encrypted tunnel over the public internet; quick and cheap; variable performance. Direct Connect (private connection, also called a dedicated link). Private, dedicated circuit to the cloud provider; predictable latency and bandwidth; costs more and takes longer to set up.

1.title: Deployment and service models
1.text: Deployment and service models. Public. Shared provider infrastructure open to many customers. Private. Dedicated to one organization (on premises or hosted). Hybrid. Public and private connected together. Software as a service. You manage: Only your data and use. Example: Email or C R M in a browser. Platform as a service. You manage: Your applications and data. Example: A managed web or database platform. Infrastructure as a service. You manage: Operating system, applications, data. Example: Virtual machines, storage, networks.

1.title: Scalability, elasticity and multitenancy
1.text: Scalability, elasticity and multitenancy. Scalability. The ability to handle growth by adding resources (up or out). Elasticity. Automatic scaling out and back in as demand changes, so you pay only for what you use. Multitenancy. Several customers share the same infrastructure, kept logically isolated. Exam tip: Scalability equals can grow. Elasticity equals grows and shrinks automatically with demand. Exam tip: A nat gateway gives outbound-only access; an internet gateway allows both directions. Security groups are stateful, network A C Ls are usually stateless.

1.title: Practice Question 1
1.text: Question one. Private instances in a cloud network must download patches but must not accept inbound internet connections. What should be used? The four options are on the screen. The answer is D: A nat gateway. A nat gateway allows outbound-only access.

1.title: Practice Question 2
1.text: Question two. A company needs a private, predictable-latency link to a cloud provider. Which option fits? The four options are on the screen. The answer is A: A dedicated private connection such as Direct Connect. Dedicated connections provide predictable performance.

1.title: Practice Question 3
1.text: Question three. Which service model gives the customer virtual machines and storage but leaves the operating system to the customer? The four options are on the screen. The answer is C: Infrastructure as a service. I A A S provides infrastructure; the customer manages the O S and above.

1.title: Practice Question 4
1.text: Question four. Which statement describes elasticity? The four options are on the screen. The answer is A: Resources grow and shrink automatically as demand changes. Elastic systems scale out and in automatically.

1.title: Practice Question 5
1.text: Question five. An organization keeps sensitive data on premises and uses a public cloud for bursts. Which deployment model is this? The four options are on the screen. The answer is B: Hybrid cloud. Combining private and public environments is hybrid.

1.title: Practice Question 6
1.text: Question six. Which device type is replaced by software when an organization applies N F V? The four options are on the screen. The answer is A: Dedicated network hardware appliances. N F V runs network functions as software on standard servers.

1.title: Recall Check 1
1.text: Recall check one. Say each answer out loud before you listen to mine. Question one. What does N F V stand for? Answer: Network functions virtualization. Question two. What does a nat gateway allow? Answer: Outbound connections from private instances without inbound reachability. Question three. Name the three cloud service models. Answer: sass, pass and I A A S.

1.title: Recall Check 2
1.text: Recall check two. Say each answer out loud before you listen to mine. Question four. What is multitenancy? Answer: Several customers sharing infrastructure, logically isolated. Question five. Which is more private, a V P N or a dedicated connection? Answer: A dedicated connection (Direct Connect). Question six. What is a V P C? Answer: A logically isolated private network inside a public cloud.

1.title: Module Recap
1.text: Here is the recap. Cloud network: V P C, security groups (stateful), network A C Ls (subnet), internet gateway, nat gateway. Connect: V P N (internet) versus Direct Connect (private link). Models: public, private, hybrid; sass, pass, I A A S. Properties: scalability, elasticity, multitenancy.
